display.title: Apotheosis: Socket Your Gear
display.subtitle: Craft a Sigil of Socketing
description: Apotheosis overhauls enchanting and adds the affix + gem-socket system.
The §dSigil of Socketing§r is the craftable tool that opens a gem socket on a
piece of gear — then drop a cut gem into that socket for a permanent bonus.
§7Affixed and socketed gear is how you push past the tiers' rising danger.
